# Install commands (test fixture — inert text, nothing here is installed or run)

Install the proxy package globally first:

    npm install -g billion-context --prefix=~/.local

Install the Caveman CLI globally:

    npx @caveman-ai/cli@latest

Install the Caveman skill package globally:

    npx skills add JuliusBrussee/caveman -g

Install the CLI-Anything skill package globally, auto-yes:

    npx skills add HKUDS/CLI-Anything --skill zoom -g -y
